newsitem.title: UK: ScotAm says tribunal available for bid disputes.
newsitem.headline: ScotAm says tribunal available for bid disputes.

text.p: Life assurer Scottish Amicable, which earlier said three potential bidders had been asked to submit formal bids, said on Thursday it has asked for a tribunal to be set up to adjudicate on any dispute that may arise.
It said the City Code on Takeovers and Mergers does not apply to the "unprecedented circumstances" of competitive bids for a mutual life company.
ScotAm said it has asked the City Disputes Panel to appoint an independent tribunal which would available to adjudicate on any dispute with any of the bidders.
The panel will be formed by Sir Patrick Neill QC, Roger Corley and William Staple.
